tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Photocopy off-white by day, flat black at night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Checklist steps, cards, sheets: the "paper taped on".

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, inputs, the progress track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All checklist text and headings, on paper, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint. 11:1+ (AAA) on all of them in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines and captions on paper and surface-raised (8.5:1+). Never a checklist instruction.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, todo-step outlines, toggle tracks. 5:1+ on paper and surface-raised.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The hard 3px border on taped-on objects: active step, buttons, callouts, stickers. Same as ink.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: The signal: hazard-tape yellow. Primary button, the active step badge, the Start card, stickers, highlighter marks. Same in both themes; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-tape
tokens.usage: Text and pictograms on a tape fill (13.2:1).

tokens.name: tape-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the active checklist step; ink text on it.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The angry red: rubber-stamp marks, advocacy headlines, strike-throughs. As text on paper, surface-raised and stamp-soft (4.9:1+). Never for checklist states, never on tape.

tokens.name: on-stamp
tokens.usage: Text on a stamp fill.

tokens.name: stamp-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind stamp text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links and info marks; as text on paper, surface-raised and action-soft.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info and rights callouts.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: "Done": badge fill, check glyph, progress fill. A blue-leaning teal, off the red-green axis. Always with a check and the word Done.

tokens.name: on-done
tokens.usage: Glyph and text on a done fill.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a completed step; ink text on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and triangle on paper, surface-raised and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Hazard stripe in warning banners (with black).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner body; ink text on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 3px solid outline, 2px offset. 13:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Fixed print ink for posters, stickers, social. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Fixed white for print and social. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Fixed stamp red for print and social on white or paper (5.3:1+). Same in both themes.

families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Hebrew", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif
families.condensed: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Hebrew", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Notice
groups.note: Condensed Noto Sans (width axis 75%, `font-stretch: 75%`), uppercase in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic. Scripts without case keep their own form at the same weight.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles on the landing page.

groups.name: Checklist
groups.note: Normal width, big and heavy: shaking hands, borrowed screens, sunlight.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Numeral in a step badge. Western digits, matching the posters.

styles.name: step
styles.usage: The one action of a step. Verb first. ink only (AAA).

styles.name: step-detail
styles.sample: Use any phone or computer. Sign in and choose “Mark as lost”.
styles.usage: The how-to line. 1.6 leading for dyslexia-friendly reading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your operator can block the phone by its IMEI. Ask. Insist.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: No app. No account. No ads.

groups.name: Typed
groups.note: The typewriter voice: labels, stamps, codes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, state chips, stamps. Uppercase only in scripts with case.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Dial codes, IMEI, reference numbers. Stays LTR inside RTL text.

spacing.note: 4px base. Checklist one step looser than reading pages.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; badge to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between lines inside a step; between steps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on larger screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Poster margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level room on desktop.

radius.note: Hard edges. Cut paper, not app chrome.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: steps, buttons, callouts, stickers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips, to stop pixel crawl on low-res screens.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Step badges (a stamped circle) and toggle thumbs only.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum size of anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button and step row height.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Step badge diameter.

tokens.name: picto-sm
tokens.usage: Inline pictograms.

tokens.name: picto-lg
tokens.usage: Pictograms leading a step or poster row.

tokens.name: border-hard
tokens.usage: Border on taped-on objects (edge colour).

shadow.note: No soft shadows. Objects sit on the page like paper: a hard offset block, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Active step, Start card, stickers: a hard offset like a pasted-up sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and the consent prompt.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus as a box-shadow: page-colour gap then 3px focus colour.

rotate.note: Tilt is the only 'rough' gesture, and it is reserved for decoration.

tokens.name: tilt-tape
tokens.usage: Tape labels and stickers on posters and social. Never on checklist text or controls.

tokens.name: tilt-stamp
tokens.usage: Stamp marks (DONE, NOT YOUR FAULT) on posters and social.
